snippet.title: Dustwind: Resistance — Gameplay Trailer (2025) | Post-Apocalyptic Tactical Game
snippet.description:
Dustwind: Resistance, a tactical real-time game set in a dark, post-apocalyptic future. The game release summer 2025 on Steam, XboxSeriesS|X and Playstation5.

Dustwind: Resistance is a brand new story set in the Dustwind universe. The story is about the resistance of a small group against crazy and cruel attackers.

The Steam Next Fest starts today (9th June 2025) - Dustwind Resistance is there with a brand new demo!

Wishlist Dustwind Resistance on 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3110370/Dustwind_Resistance/
Playstation5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014598
XboxSeriesS|X: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/dustwind-resistance/9nc3c9zx5b7w

🎮 Join us on discord and become part of the Dustwind community: https://discord.gg/DSvj7Zf

Website: https://www.dustwind.com
